correctness.rationale: For normalized Gaussian measure pi^{-1}exp(-|z|²)dA, diagonal Hermite-sector eigenvalues λ_n=1/(2n!)∫_0^x exp(-t)t^{n-2}F_n(t)²dt with F_n(t)=t²-2nt+n(n-1); cancellations at n=0,1 are valid. Independently symbolic differentiation verifies λ_n-λ_{n+1}=exp(-x)x^{n-1} F_n(x)F_{n+1}(x)/(2(n+1)!). As a polynomial of index n, F_n(x)=(n-r_-)(n-r_+), with r±=x+1/2±sqrt(x+1/4). Its integer sign structure shows that the global maximum lies at n=0,ceil r_-,ceil r_+, including ties; λ_n→0. At x=3 the three local maxima occur at 0,2,6. Triple equality centered n iff F_n(x)=0 iff x=n±sqrt(n)>0. Integer-index positive-root coincidences arise only for consecutive squares a²,(a+1)² at x=a(a+1), and cannot yield four consecutive equal terms. The independent polynomial check and triangular root checks corroborate the analysis.
